title: Members list
summary: Lists church members and supports opening the member registration flow.
whenToUse: You need to review or manage members already registered in the system
avoidWhen: You are trying to register a financial posting or treasury movement

title: Create member
summary: Registers a new member in the church directory.
whenToUse: The church needs to create a new member record before using member-dependent flows
avoidWhen: The person is already registered as a member

title: Roles and permissions
summary: Manages role permissions for the ERP modules.
whenToUse: You need to review or change which permissions each role has
avoidWhen: You only need to post a financial movement

title: Users and access
summary: Manages user access, assigned roles and authorization inside the ERP.
whenToUse: You need to grant or review system access for a user
avoidWhen: You only need to configure accounting or treasury records

title: Register financial record
summary: Registers an income or expense already paid or received with immediate cash impact.
whenToUse: Cash already moved
You want to register income or expense directly
avoidWhen: The obligation exists but has not been paid yet
You need to create a payable or receivable commitment first

title: Contributions list
summary: Lists online or member-submitted contributions for treasury review, approval or rejection.
whenToUse: You need to review contributions already submitted through the member contribution flow
Treasury must approve or reject a submitted receipt or online contribution
avoidWhen: You need to manually register money already received at treasury
You need to create a new direct income record in cash or bank

title: Create account payable
summary: Registers a supplier or payment commitment that still has pending installments.
whenToUse: The church has a debt or bill pending payment
You need to control due dates and future payments
avoidWhen: The expense was already paid and should go directly to financial record

title: Create account receivable
summary: Registers an amount the church expects to receive in the future.
whenToUse: There is a future incoming commitment
You need to track installments to collect later
avoidWhen: The amount was already received and should go directly to financial record

title: Accounts payable list
summary: Lists payables, installments and pending commitments already registered by the church.
whenToUse: You need to review payable commitments, due dates or installments
You want to open an existing payable to settle or verify it
avoidWhen: You need to register a brand-new direct expense already paid

title: Account payable detail
summary: Shows a payable detail with installments, reconciliation and payment follow-up.
whenToUse: You need to inspect or settle a specific payable
You want to confirm due dates, supplier and payment history
avoidWhen: You need to create a new payable from scratch

title: Accounts receivable list
summary: Lists receivables, expected collections and future commitments already registered.
whenToUse: You need to review amounts the church still expects to receive
You want to open an existing receivable for collection follow-up
avoidWhen: The money was already received and should be posted directly in treasury

title: Account receivable detail
summary: Shows the detail of a receivable with installments, expected collections and payment applications.
whenToUse: You need to inspect a specific receivable before collecting or applying a payment
You want to review debtor, schedule and collection history
avoidWhen: You need to create a new receivable from scratch

title: Member commitments
summary: Lets members review or confirm their own commitments and payment obligations.
whenToUse: The question is about a member viewing or confirming commitments
You need to support a member-side receivable flow rather than treasury posting
avoidWhen: You need to register treasury income directly

title: Financial concepts list
summary: Lists and filters financial concepts configured for the church.
whenToUse: You need to review or search concepts
You want to edit an existing concept
avoidWhen: You need to register a movement directly

title: Create financial concept
summary: Creates a new financial concept to classify future movements.
whenToUse: No existing concept fits the case
You need a reusable concept for future transactions
avoidWhen: An existing concept already matches the use case

title: Availability accounts
summary: Manages cash, bank and availability accounts used in financial records.
whenToUse: You need to review or create accounts where money is available
avoidWhen: You only need to register a movement using an existing account

title: Create availability account
summary: Creates a new availability account used in financial records and cash-impact flows.
whenToUse: The church needs a new cash, wallet, bank or investment account for postings
avoidWhen: An existing availability account already covers the need

title: Cost centers
summary: Manages cost centers used to classify outgoing movements.
whenToUse: You need to configure or review cost centers for expenses
avoidWhen: You only need to register a movement with an existing center

title: Create cost center
summary: Creates a new cost center to classify expenses by area, ministry or project.
whenToUse: The current cost centers do not cover the area or project that should receive the expense
avoidWhen: An existing center already matches the classification need

title: Register purchase
summary: Registers a purchase flow with invoice attachment and purchase-specific data.
whenToUse: You need the purchase workflow and invoice handling
The expense belongs to the purchases module
avoidWhen: A normal financial record is enough

title: Purchases list
summary: Lists purchase records and helps review the purchasing workflow already registered in the system.
whenToUse: You need to review prior purchases or continue the purchase workflow
avoidWhen: You need to create a normal financial record rather than a purchase flow

title: Banks list
summary: Lists configured banks used by banking and reconciliation flows.
whenToUse: You need to review available banks before bank reconciliation or setup
avoidWhen: You already know the bank is configured and only need to reconcile movements

title: Create bank
summary: Creates a bank entry used later by banking and account configuration flows.
whenToUse: The bank is missing from configuration
avoidWhen: The bank already exists and the user only needs to create postings

title: Bank reconciliation
summary: Imports statements and manages reconciliation status for bank movements.
whenToUse: You need to import a bank statement
You want to reconcile pending or unmatched bank movements
avoidWhen: You only need to create a financial posting without reconciliation

title: Suppliers list
summary: Lists suppliers used by purchases and payable flows.
whenToUse: You need to review or reuse an existing supplier
avoidWhen: You only need to create a single movement without supplier context

title: Create supplier
summary: Registers a supplier to be reused in purchases and accounts payable.
whenToUse: The church needs to register a new supplier before payable or purchase flows
avoidWhen: The supplier already exists

title: Financial months
summary: Manages open, closed and reopened financial months for period control.
whenToUse: You need to close or reopen a financial month
avoidWhen: You only need to register a movement inside an already open period

title: Church profile
summary: Manages church profile information and related institutional settings.
whenToUse: You need to review or change church profile information
avoidWhen: You need to register a financial movement

title: Internal transfers
summary: Lists transfers between availability accounts without treating them as income or expense.
whenToUse: You need to review movements already made between church accounts
avoidWhen: You need to register a normal income, expense or purchase

title: Create internal transfer
summary: Registers a transfer between church availability accounts.
whenToUse: Money is moving from one church cash or bank account to another
avoidWhen: The transaction is a real expense, income or supplier payment

title: Patrimony assets list
summary: Lists church assets under patrimony control and supports inventory, editing and lifecycle tracking.
whenToUse: You need to review church goods already registered
You want to manage inventory, status or patrimony history
avoidWhen: You only need to register a normal cash movement without asset tracking

title: Create patrimony asset
summary: Registers a new asset for church patrimony with identification, value, category and lifecycle data.
whenToUse: You need to register an equipment, furniture item, instrument or other church good
You want future inventory and disposal control
avoidWhen: The transaction only needs a financial posting and not patrimony lifecycle control

title: Monthly tithes report
summary: Shows tithe performance for the selected period and treasury context.
whenToUse: You need to review tithe income in a month or period
You want to analyze tithe concentration or trend
avoidWhen: You need to register a new contribution directly

title: Income statement
summary: Displays the period result with revenue, expenses, balances and cost center pressure.
whenToUse: You need to understand the financial result for the period
You want to analyze revenue versus expenses and surplus or deficit
avoidWhen: You need to post a new transaction

title: DRE report
summary: Shows the statement of results for the period with direct and operational result analysis.
whenToUse: You need an operational result view of the period
You want to review profitability, direct costs and operating pressure
avoidWhen: You only need a treasury posting flow

title: Gloria Assistance
summary: Central support assistant to answer product, accounting and contextual workflow questions.
whenToUse: You need guidance about a screen, registration flow, concept or report
You want to analyze a document or ask a contextual question
avoidWhen: You already know the exact operational screen and only need to execute the action
